reason: P07-08 reuses the existing operator ledger handlers for explicit allowlisted target routes, validates URL/body targets before connecting, and adds a repeatable-read summary of the latest started period and all started overdue balances independent of history pagination. SubscriptionTargetLedgerTests exercise two real PostgreSQL firms, same keys and references in separate firms, target/version mismatches, exact replay after commit, parallel payments, atomic failed/successful corrections and reversals, all56-table business-data preservation, Istanbul midnight, future-only/empty and older-than-page debts, legacy summary parity, MFA/CSRF/validation/429 and isolated firm outage. SubscriptionTargetsTests retain allowlist, marker, role and legacy fail-closed checks. SubscriptionOperatorTests retain existing single-firm financial callers, provisioning and identity revocation. SubscriptionAccessTests and SubscriptionTests cover agreement with normal firm read-only rules and unchanged Owner privacy. Existing operator UI and common API tests cover backward compatibility of the additive single-firm response. No normal Server/Web, schema, migration, grants, dependency or deployment configuration changes; normal8080 source/image remains unchanged, and the operator image gets an exact-source packaging/startup acceptance.
